name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Place a kettlebell on the ground between your feet.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grip the kettlebell with both hands.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs to generate momentum.
Drive explosively through your hips to swing the kettlebell forward and up.
Let the kettlebell rise to about chest or shoulder height.
Keep your arms relatively straight, letting the hip drive power the movement.
As the kettlebell descends, hinge at the hips and guide it back between your legs.
Immediately begin the next repetition in a smooth, rhythmic motion.
